# DEVCOWISE Technologies

DEVCOWISE is an enterprise-grade digital transformation, custom ERP integration, high-performance cloud migration, Kubernetes orchestration, and Generative AI consulting partner.

## Core Capabilities

- **Enterprise ERP Deployments**: Specializing in custom SAP S/4HANA migrations, Frappe / ERPNext customizations, and Odoo multi-tenant setups.
- **AI & Analytics (Generative AI)**: Custom agentic workflows, secure server-authoritative RAG applications, and private LLM model isolation with full data governance.
- **Cloud & DevOps (Kubernetes)**: Multi-region zero-trust cloud migrations (AWS, Azure, GCP), Terraform Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Istio service meshes, and containerized scale-out architectures.
- **Cybersecurity & Vulnerability Audits**: Penetration testing, Zero-Trust compliance, and network hardening against modern security threats.
- **Custom Enterprise Software**: Full-stack tailored React, Node.js, and Python systems backed by high-availability cloud databases.
